description: This file defines the GCSBucketLogger class that extends GCSBucketBase and AdditionalLoggingUtils to provide logging functionality to Google Cloud Storage. It includes methods for asynchronous logging of success and failure events, batch processing of logs, generating object names based on request details, retrieving payloads from GCS, and performing health checks. The class is designed for premium users and manages batched log uploads with configurable batch size and flush interval.

classes.name: GCSBucketLogger
classes.description: A logger class for GCS that handles batching, asynchronous logging, and retrieval of logs from Google Cloud Storage, inheriting from GCSBucketBase and AdditionalLoggingUtils.

methods.name: async_log_success_event(self, kwargs, response_obj, start_time, end_time)
methods.description: Asynchronously logs a success event by appending it to the internal log queue after validation of premium user status.

methods.name: async_log_failure_event(self, kwargs, response_obj, start_time, end_time)
methods.description: Asynchronously logs a failure event similarly to success events, adding to the log queue.

methods.name: async_send_batch(self)
methods.description: Processes the queued logs in batch, making individual POST requests to GCS for each log, then clears the queue.

methods.name: str _get_object_name( self, kwargs: Dict, logging_payload: StandardLoggingPayload, response_obj: Any )
methods.description: Generates the object name for the log based on whether it's a success or failure, with optional override via metadata.

methods.name: Optional[dict] get_request_response_payload( self, request_id: str, start_time_utc: Optional[datetime], end_time_utc: Optional[datetime], )
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve the payload for a request ID by checking current, next, and previous day's logs in GCS.

methods.name: str _generate_success_object_name( self, request_date_str: str, response_id: str, )
methods.description: Creates an object name for successful request logs, combining date and response ID.

methods.name: str _generate_failure_object_name( self, request_date_str: str, )
methods.description: Creates an object name for failure logs, appending a UUID.

methods.name: str _get_object_date_from_datetime(self, datetime_obj: datetime)
methods.description: Formats a datetime object to a date string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

methods.name: IntegrationHealthCheckStatus async_health_check(self)
methods.description: Stub method indicating that GCS Bucket does not support health checks, raises NotImplementedError.
